body: The map’s route is marked closed at 0600, then annotated ‘through traffic exempted, program vehicles only.’ The clipboard underneath still lists the old schedule, with no name entered for who signed the exemption.
title: The route stayed open for one kind of traffic
gloss: A road closure carries an exemption for ‘program vehicles’ with no signed authorization.
rival_reading: An agricultural program could route its own vehicles through a closure using the same exemption language; an unsigned exemption alone does not show a failed evacuation.

body: The requisition names a field-office allocation by program number only, no address given. The padlock keyed to it was checked out twice in one week, under two different initials. A grocery list is clipped behind, half crossed off.
title: The field office key never left the ring
gloss: A field-office requisition names a program number with no address; the padlock keyed to it was checked out twice under different initials.
rival_reading: A containment operation also runs field offices near a restricted area; a shared program number and a double checkout do not by themselves point to agriculture rather than an emergency response post.
